gizmo.title: Maramataka
gizmo.description: Whakaaturia ngā takahanga o tētahi kōnae maramataka hei kāri rā, hei rārangi wā, hei ripanga, hei rārangi rānei.

configure.title: Kōnae maramataka
configure.description: Tukuake, kōwhiri rānei i tētahi kōnae maramataka .ics. Ka pānuitia ōna takahanga i te pūtirotiro.

configure.title: Whakaatu hei
configure.description: Me pēhea te whakaatu i ngā ihirangi o te kōnae.

configure.title: Upoko
configure.description: Ka whakaaturia ki runga ake i ngā takahanga, ā, hei tapanga ripanga. Ko te taunoa ko te ingoa ake o te maramataka.
